_comment: Cutouts: one flat picture per actor, and per thing that has one (the padlock), hung by the graybox where the room puts it.
Dev-owned, not part of a design package. Each entry points at a PNG under wwwroot/assets/characters and
states the figure's real height in metres. Width is NOT stated: it follows the image's own aspect, so the
two can never disagree. `depth` is footprint only -- it keeps a figure clear of exit lanes and never changes
what is drawn, and it is deliberately independent of the displayed width, because an oversized held prop
widens the silhouette without widening the man (design agent, DR-095, 2026-09-12).
`provisional` marks a cutout taken from a concept sheet rather than delivered as a production asset.
